title: Find a Peak Element
summary: Find any index whose value is larger than both neighbours in O(log n): compare the middle with its right neighbour and always move toward the rising side, which must contain a peak.

inputs.name: values
inputs.label: Array values
inputs.note: Neighbouring values must be different. The array does not need to be sorted.

anchors.label: While more than one candidate remains
Does the slope rise to the right?
